answer_1.quote: We propose Chain-of-Thought Enhanced Knowledge Rewriting, CoTKR... converting triples into natural language... This process is referred to as Knowledge Rewriting (KR) in this study.
answer_1.outputs: Natural-language knowledge representations (summaries) used as context for QA

answer_2.quote: We adopt Accuracy (Acc) as one of our evaluation metrics... we also use Recall, Exact Match (EM), and GPT-4-score.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4 as the evaluator to assess whether all answer entities are present in the responses... we also prompt ChatGPT to assess the quality of a1 and a2 from the perspectives of accuracy and relevance.
